subject: Confirming what we agreed
opener: Thanks for the time today. Here is what we agreed.

bullets.text: You are in: a two-location ninety-day pilot at twenty six per seat, recall tooling included.
The price that landed is twenty six per seat, with recall tooling included.
I am sending the agreement this afternoon.
Dr. Mehta signs early next week.
We aim the cutover for the weekend after signing.
I will set up the training live-review of call recordings for your office manager during onboarding, with no extra line item.

close: Every line above came from something said on the call. If I got any of it wrong, tell me and I will fix it.
